title: Sustainable loan products with embedded Floras
floras_mechanism: A lender embeds Floras into selected loan products so that part of the loan economics funds verified sustainability projects. The borrower receives a differentiated financing product, while the lender creates a visible climate-linked feature without needing to redesign the entire lending process.
pain_signals: financial products are hard to differentiate
existing green loan products lack an ongoing impact layer
budget_source: Product margin allocation; ESG product budget; marketing budget; sustainable finance innovation budget
safe_claims: Floras can add a visible sustainability-linked layer to loan products
Borrowers can see part of the product value directed toward verified projects
The lender can use Floras to make sustainable finance more tangible
conditional_claims: If loan proceeds are already tied to green activities, Floras can complement the product narrative
If the lender tracks borrower sectors, Floras allocation can be aligned with relevant project types
avoid_claims: The loan itself is automatically green
This replaces formal green loan frameworks or sustainability-linked loan standards

output_templates.one_liner: Make {company_name}'s sustainable loan products more tangible with embedded Floras.
output_templates.short_pitch: {company_name} can use Floras to add a climate-linked value layer to selected loan products. A small portion of the product economics can generate Floras that borrowers allocate toward verified projects, helping the lender differentiate sustainable finance products with visible impact rather than abstract ESG positioning.

objections_and_responses.objection: We already have green loan or sustainability-linked loan products.
objections_and_responses.response: Floras complements formal green loan frameworks—it adds an ongoing, visible impact layer borrowers can engage with, rather than replacing certification standards or use-of-proceeds requirements.

objections_and_responses.objection: Borrowers care about rate and terms, not climate features.
objections_and_responses.response: Floras targets differentiation in sustainable finance segments where borrowers and stakeholders already expect tangible ESG value. It makes the sustainability story concrete without changing core underwriting.

objections_and_responses.objection: Impact claims on lending products attract scrutiny.
objections_and_responses.response: Position Floras as allocated value toward verified projects with documentation, not as automatic emissions reduction from the loan itself. Stay within safe claims and avoid implying the loan is green by default.
